verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs describe architectures where SumUp systems handle card capture. Hosted Checkout puts the payment page on SumUp's side, and with the Cloud API the transaction is completed on a Solo reader. The offline flow also states that card data is captured and cached securely on the device. However, nothing in the pack mentions PCI, reader certification (e.g. PCI PTS/P2PE), or guidance on the merchant's remaining PCI obligations. Missing for 10: explicit PCI-scope documentation, evidence of reader/vendor certification, vendor guidance on remaining obligations (SAQ type, etc.), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my PCI scope minimal because card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers and vendor systems, with vendor guidance on my remaining obligations

citations.quote: SumUp hosts the payment page, while your integration creates the checkout and redirects the customer to the returned URL.
complete that transaction via a Solo reader
card data is captured and cached securely on the device, then uploaded later for processing and authorization
